transcript.speaker: agent
transcript.text: Hello! I'm Dora, and I'm here to help with any questions you may have about your cataract surgery recovery. How are you feeling today? Do you have any questions about your surgery or recovery?

transcript.speaker: patient
transcript.text: Hi Dora! I'm doing alright, thank you. I do have a few questions. When can I start doing a little bit of gardening?

transcript.speaker: agent
transcript.text: You can start with light gardening, such as brisk walking, gardening, gentle cycling, about 1 week after surgery. Just be sure to avoid getting water in your eyes and take breaks if you need to. Also, remember to wear protective eyewear.

transcript.speaker: patient
transcript.text: That's great to know, thank you! I was also wondering, when can I start using my eye gel for dry eyes?

transcript.speaker: agent
transcript.text: You should continue using the preservative-free eye drops as prescribed. If you're running out, you can get some more from your GP. It's safe to use them as directed.

transcript.speaker: patient
transcript.text: Okay, got it. I have another question. I'm very sensitive to bright light. Is that normal?

transcript.speaker: agent
transcript.text: It's normal to have some sensitivity to light after cataract surgery, but if it's severe or accompanied by redness and pain, we may need to take a closer look. Mild sensitivity, though, is common and can be helped by wearing sunglasses outside. Would you like to know more about that?

transcript.speaker: patient
transcript.text: Thanks, that helps. My last question is, should I still have some blurriness by now?

transcript.speaker: agent
transcript.text: It's common to have blurry vision for a little while after surgery, but it should improve quickly. If your vision is still blurry or getting worse, we may need to check it to make sure everything is okay.

transcript.speaker: patient
transcript.text: Alright, thanks for the information. I don't have any more questions now. I appreciate your help!

transcript.speaker: agent
transcript.text: You're welcome! I'm glad I could help. Just to confirm, all your questions about your cataract surgery recovery have been answered, correct?

verdict.label: pass

The `mild_case_advice` was also conveyed in turn 6 with, "Mild sensitivity, though, is common and can be helped by wearing sunglasses outside." All points were covered.
